## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `38d1ac7f9faa25ec8a15cb6cb0b4fe262c284f74`
Local-runs: none
Scope: AGENTS.md (§Build & Test, §Multi-agent working discipline, the new `## Contents` block), docs/agents/README.md, docs/agents/build-and-test.md, docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (the `AGENTS.md` CEILINGS row) + CONTRIBUTING.md (its 10 `AGENTS.md#…` links, read not reviewed), the ruling record 6417533492 (letter A)

Read at 2026-10-28T08:11Z by the `domain:skills#2` seat on the fetched head (merge-base `07d18e69`, `origin/main` now `4db45988`): five files, +453/−165, 618 changed lines ≤ 3000. Tier H by path (`AGENTS.md`); the approval of record is `os-zhuang`'s APPROVED review on this head (2026-10-28T08:05Z), who also readied the PR and armed auto-merge — the seat flipped nothing. Both `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` were requested by the relay `pr_create` run (2026-10-28T08:03Z); `hotlong` remains requested. This record is the surface-owed review.

### ① Derived judgments

- The ruling's condition is 「no rule is restated, only its explanation moves」. Measured on the head, read-only: (a) `git diff --color-moved=zebra --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change origin/main...HEAD -- AGENTS.md docs/agents/` → 107 lines moved out of `AGENTS.md` and 107 moved into the pages (verbatim); the 57 remaining removed lines are each a line that a fragment left mid-line (the staying half re-wrapped), and the 339 plain-added lines are the pages' headings and preambles, the 23-line `## Contents` block, the 31 `([why](docs/agents/…#…))` pointers and the re-wrapped rule sentences. (b) A sliding 70-character window over the two BASE sections (33,295 chars) against the union of head `AGENTS.md` + both pages: 73 windows unmatched in 67 runs of one or two windows — every run sits on a cut boundary (a window spanning a staying sentence and a moved one), none spans a paragraph; a lost explanation would have shown as a long run. (c) Headings: identical to `origin/main` except the added `## Contents`; Prime Directives and Monorepo Layout → end are byte-equal; only the two named sections changed (140→125, 317→247). (d) ⛔-bearing lines: 60 before, 60 after (the dev counts 66 occurrences; the line count is the seat's). Holds.
- The dev's declared new text is bounded and named: 9 staying sentences newly cut from the paragraph they head (listed in the PR body's table) and 2 antecedent adjustments to ⛔ sentences whose referent moved (「Do not carry it over」 → 「Do not carry the `--` separator over」; §7's 「Arming a red PR does not queue it, it hides it」 folded as 「arming a red PR hides it」 into the green-means-success sentence). Read on the head: each keeps the rule's force and names its object where the moved paragraph used to; no rule weakened, none added.
- Anchors: 29 `docs/agents/*.md#anchor` pointers in `AGENTS.md` resolve against the pages' headings (GitHub slug form, recomputed here: 0 unresolved); the 17 `## Contents` anchors resolve against `AGENTS.md`'s own `##` headings (0 unresolved); the pages back-link `../../AGENTS.md#build--test` and `#multi-agent-working-discipline`, both present. The dev's own verifier additionally checked CONTRIBUTING.md's 10 anchor links (7 distinct), all present on the new file.
- Ratchet: `CEILINGS['AGENTS.md']` 1112 → 1050 with a provenance comment quoting the ruling; a LOWERING, the ratchet's ordinary direction (no ceiling-raise ruling needed); landed count, headroom 0; the widest-row pin 768 unchanged (the widest row is the untouched translations row). Correct.
- The pages' preamble states the authority order (`AGENTS.md` wins; a paragraph read as a rule binds in `AGENTS.md`'s spelling) and the pull-back procedure (edit `AGENTS.md`, delete here, one PR) — the 「一处维护」 invariant of `CLAUDE.md` survives: each explanation exists in exactly one place, each rule in exactly one place.

### ② Semver level

- None owed: documentation and a repo script; no package touched. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body match the claim; no `Skills-docs:` line owed. `skip-changeset` correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Route sizing hypothesis falsified by the dev's measurement: the seat's order expected roughly a third off; the landed cut is −62 lines / −6,177 bytes (the two sections are ~2/3 rule sentences under the order's own test). Accepted: a larger cut would compress rules, which the ruling refuses; the maintainer can pull any fragment back by name from the PR body's table.
- `check-links` family NOT MEASURED locally (lychee absent in the container); `check-links.yml` (advisory) covers `docs/**/*.md` on the PR; the dev's verifier and the seat's anchor check cover the relative links.
- The ruling's PR 2 (CONTRIBUTING + template) landed as #26375 before this PR 1; #26035 (the serialization gate) is closed. `ui/AGENTS.md`'s sibling card #25919 PR 2 has not landed, so no in-repo precedent sized this; the cloud precedent (cloud#3194) was not readable from this repo.
- Dev deviations accepted: the shared checkout was at `3230bdbf` when read, every edit taken from the worktree at `07d18e69`; the first detached `check:pm-dispatch-gates` run lacked exit capture and was re-run with it (EXIT 0); `check:doc-formula-expressions` exit 3 (prerequisite not built) then exit 0 after building formula+lint under the verify lock.
- Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; `mcp_calls: 0`; the ready flip and the auto-merge arm are `os-zhuang`'s acts.

### ④ Design judgment

- Against the card's scenario (a first-time contributor, and every seat session, loads an 82 KB file with no navigation): the file now opens with a 17-entry map, the two heaviest sections carry one executable sentence per rule with the explanation one link away, and nothing a hook or gate reads moved (`check:pm-governed-prose` and `check-published-list-mirrors` green per the dev's derived run). Against the four-axis frame: long-run, the two-tier shape (hard rules in the root, explanations in topic pages) is the one the maintainer already chose for cloud; focus, no rule added; AI-error, every ⛔ stays in the file the hooks and seats load. Holds. Residual: the pointer form `([why](…))` adds 31 parentheticals to rule sentences — a reader skimming for rules now also skims past links; acceptable, and the alternative (footnotes) would move the pointers away from the rule they explain.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-26081-agents-md-toc-and-topic-pages`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读 — 席位终稿 · PR #27139 · head `38d1ac7f` · `domain:skills#2` · 2026-10-28T08:13Z

- 改了什么:`AGENTS.md` 开头加一张 17 条目的目录(`## Contents`,GitHub 锚点);§Build & Test 与 §Multi-agent working discipline 里 34 段「为什么」的机制说明逐字节迁到 `docs/agents/build-and-test.md`、`docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md`(索引 `docs/agents/README.md`),每条规则仍留在 `AGENTS.md`:一句可执行的话 + 一个 `([why](…))` 指针(31 个)。`AGENTS.md` 1112 → 1050 行;行数棘轮上限随之下调到 1050(下调不需裁决)。其余 15 节与 Prime Directives 逐字节未动。
- 为什么改:裁决 6417533492 字母 A(「其他同意」2026-10-26T13:43Z):规则留一处、解释迁出;每个会话都加载这份文件,读到的是更短、可导航的规则本。
- 风险与回滚:风险只有一种 —— 某段被判为「解释」迁走而你认为它是规则;PR 正文的表按来源行逐段列出落点,任一段可单独拉回(改 `AGENTS.md` 并从 `docs/agents/` 删同段)。席位实测:60 条带 ⛔ 的行一条未少;`git diff --color-moved` 107 行迁出 = 107 行迁入;两节原文的 70 字滑窗只在切割边界缺配,无整段丢失。回滚 = revert 单个 commit。
- 先看:PR 正文「Moved paragraphs」表里 dev 自评风险最高的三处(§7 Re-arm awareness 整段迁出只留一句新裁句;§11 合并驱动五段;§9 过期产物表);以及 9 句新裁的留句与 2 处 ⛔ 句的先行词调整(正文点名)。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff --color-moved=zebra origin/main...HEAD -- AGENTS.md docs/agents/`(迁出段两侧成对着色);`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 预期 `AGENTS.md is 1050 lines (ceiling 1050; headroom 0)`。
- 需要你做的:无 —— os-zhuang 已于 2026-10-28T08:05Z 批准、翻 ready 并挂 auto-merge(Tier H 人批在案);席位未动它,跟到 MERGED。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。裁决条件「只迁解释、不复述规则」席位用三种独立读数核过(标题集、⛔ 行数、迁移检测 + 滑窗守恒);「约砍三分之一」的路线假设被 dev 实测推翻(−5.6%),理由成立:再砍即压缩规则,裁决不许。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01QSeKYmhU5KEj1nukYhp1Tg` · 2026-10-28T08:13Z

1. 形态:ready(os-zhuang 翻)→ main,auto-merge 在挂;首行 `Fixes #26081`,`Clause-②: no`、`Metadata-protocol: none`、`Ruling-ref: 6417533492` 行首在;五个文件 +453/−165(618 行 ≤ 3000);assignee os-justin;`skip-changeset` 正确;单 commit。
2. 前提实测:席位在取回的 head(merge-base `07d18e69`)上核 —— 标题集与 `origin/main` 仅差新增 `## Contents`;Prime Directives 与 Monorepo Layout→文末逐字节相等;只有两节变动(140→125、317→247);⛔ 行 60→60;29 个页面指针 + 17 个目录锚点 0 未解析;棘轮行 1112→1050 带出处注释;PR 2(#26375)已落、#26035 已关(裁决的串行条件满足)。
3. 门禁 check-runs(head `38d1ac7f`,本笔读数 2026-10-28T08:13Z):46 check-runs,25 success · 19 skipped · 2 in progress · 0 failure(draft=False mergeable_state=blocked auto_merge=True)。dev 本地派生 40/40 exit 0 钉 `38d1ac7f`(报告 6463914093);`check-links` 族本地 NOT MEASURED(容器无 lychee),由 PR 上的 advisory lane 跑,相对链接由 dev 校验器与席位锚点核对覆盖。
4. 接受的偏差:① 路线「约砍三分之一」被实测推翻,落地 −62 行(−5.6%),理由是两节三分之二为规则句;② 9 句新裁留句 + 2 处 ⛔ 先行词调整(正文点名,席位逐句读过,力度未减);③ 共享检出当时在 `3230bdbf`,所有编辑取自 `07d18e69` 的 worktree;④ `check:pm-dispatch-gates` 首跑无退出码捕获、重跑 EXIT 0。
5. 范围外去向:none filed;dev 无 out_of_scope_findings。`Skills-docs:` 不欠(kind none)。
6. 落地条款:Tier H;授权批准(os-zhuang APPROVED,head `38d1ac7f`)在案,本人已 ready + 挂 auto-merge;契约复核 PASS 评论 6464008250;席位不再动它,MERGED 后关卡摘 `pm:dispatched`。
